description.zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：
- **PrePaid**：预付费，包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：按量付费。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **PrePaid**: subscription

- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go
The database engine version of the instance. Valid values: **5.0**, **4.4**, **4.2**, **4.0**, and **3.4**.

description.zh:
实例规格。不同类型实例的规格分别请参见：

- [单节点实例规格表](~~311407~~)
- [副本集实例规格表](~~311410~~)
- [分片集群实例规格表](~~311414~~)

<props="china">
> Serverless实例不需要传入该参数。</props>
description.en:
The instance type. For more information about the instance types available for different instance architectures, see:

- [Standalone instance types](~~311407~~)

- [Replica set instance types](~~311410~~)

- [Sharded cluster instance types](~~311414~~)

<props="china">

> This parameter is not required for Serverless instances.

</props>

description.zh:
需要查询概览的实例ID。

> - 如果不传入该参数，默认查询当前阿里云账号下的所有实例。
> - 支持传入多个实例ID，实例ID之间以英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The ID of the instance whose overview you want to query.

> - If you do not specify this parameter, an overview of all instances in your Alibaba Cloud account is returned.
>
> - You can specify multiple instance IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 实例的状态信息，取值详情请参见[实例状态表](~~63870~~)。
description.en: The status of the instance. For more information, see [Instance states](~~63870~~).

description.zh:
实例类型，取值： 
- **sharding**：分片集群实例。
- **replicate**：副本集实例和单节点实例。
<props="china">
- **serverless**：Serverless实例。
</props>

> - 请根据实际需求配置，例如您需要查询分片集群实例的概览，则配置该参数的值为**sharding**。
> - 不配置该参数时，默认查询所有实例的概览。
description.en:
The instance architecture. Valid values:

- **sharding**: sharded cluster instance

- **replicate**: replica set or standalone instance

<props="china">

- **serverless**: Serverless instance

</props>


> * Set this parameter as needed. For example, to query the overview of a sharded cluster instance, set this parameter to **sharding**.
>
> * If you do not specify this parameter, an overview of all instances is returned.

description.zh:
实例的网络类型，取值：
- **Classic**：经典网络。
- **VPC**：VPC网络。
description.en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

- **Classic**: classic network

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC)
The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) to query the latest region list.

description.zh: 资源组ID。资源组详情请参见[查看资源组基本信息](~~151181~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see [View basic information about a resource group](~~151181~~).

description.zh: 是否展示实例标签，默认值 false。
description.en: Specifies whether to return instance tags. The default value is false.

descriptions.zh:
- 如果您未指定实例的具体信息，则返回当前账号的目标地域下所有实例的概览信息。

- 该接口返回结果不进行分页。
descriptions.en:
- If you do not specify any instances, the operation returns overview information for all instances in the destination region associated with your Alibaba Cloud account.
- The results of this operation are not paginated.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-db-instances-overview --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids dds-bp12c5b040dc0000 --instance-status Running --charge-type PostPaid --network-type Classic --engine-version 4.0 --instance-class dds.mongo.2xlarge --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --instance-type replicate --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --show-tags false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeDBInstancesOverview --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '4.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000' --InstanceClass 'dds.mongo.2xlarge' --VpcId 'vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000' --InstanceStatus Running --ChargeType PostPaid --NetworkType Classic --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceIds 'dds-bp12c5b040dc0000' --InstanceType replicate --ShowTags false
